invariants.name: WorkspaceLineage
invariants.rule: Opening/base sourceRevision and currentHeadRevision are distinct durable/projection facts; reconnect must not reconstruct them from caller memory.
invariants.negative: Current HEAD must not overwrite opening lineage.

invariants.name: WorkspaceSourceStateCAS
invariants.rule: Mutating or closing a Workspace may be guarded by exact source-state identity; active committed execution blocks unsafe mutation/close.
invariants.negative: Stale state must not be removed or mutated as if current.

invariants.name: ClientRequestIdentityLaw
invariants.rule: clientRequestId obeys one canonical bounded identity law across public Tools.
invariants.negative: Whitespace/control/invalid identity variants must not create ambiguous Jobs.

invariants.name: ExactReplayBeforeWorldReevaluation
invariants.rule: Exact replay returns the committed historical Job before consulting current mutable world/authority.
invariants.negative: Replay must never become redispatch or reinterpretation under current policy.

invariants.name: JobAttemptSeparation
invariants.rule: Job is logical durable execution identity; Attempt is physical realization and may be reconstructed without inventing a new Job.
invariants.negative: Physical restart must not create a second logical operation.

invariants.name: DurableCapacityReservation
invariants.rule: Global and Workspace execution capacity are represented by durable reservations and cannot be overbooked.
invariants.negative: Restart or concurrent admission must not reset/overbook capacity.

invariants.name: NoHiddenQueue
invariants.rule: Runtime admits now or rejects now; rejected capacity does not create deferred hidden execution intent.
invariants.negative: Capacity rejection must not enqueue work or later dispatch without a new/committed Job.

invariants.name: CancellationDurability
invariants.rule: Cancellation intent is durable, stops the owned physical process tree, and reconciles terminal truth.
invariants.negative: Local caller cancellation must not be mistaken for physical termination.

invariants.name: TerminalCommitAtomicity
invariants.rule: Terminalization is atomic/idempotent and releases capacity only when terminal truth is durable.
invariants.negative: Incomplete evidence must not release capacity or guess success.

invariants.name: ArtifactIdentity
invariants.rule: Artifacts are bounded, digest-bound, and attributable to exact Job/Attempt truth.
invariants.negative: Artifact bytes must not be silently substituted or treated as semantic completion.

invariants.name: AmbiguityNoBlindRedispatch
invariants.rule: Ambiguous/lost/orphaned physical state remains explicit until evidence permits convergence.
invariants.negative: UNKNOWN must never become permission to rerun or success.

invariants.name: ProviderCommitment
invariants.rule: New Jobs freeze the exact provider realization identity needed for execution/recovery.
invariants.negative: Provider drift must not silently realize a different physical contract.

invariants.name: ImmutableInputFreeze
invariants.rule: Named-authority input bytes are verified/materialized only on new admission and replay no longer depends on live authority bytes.
invariants.negative: Source authority drift/loss must not mutate committed Job inputs.

invariants.name: CredentialBinding
invariants.rule: Credential selection is opaque/authority-gated; Runtime snapshots encrypted bytes without exposing plaintext/path/digest to callers.
invariants.negative: Principal checks may not occur after secret object resolution and plaintext must not enter the Job request.

invariants.name: HostDependencyContinuityScope
invariants.rule: Declared trusted-local Host Dependencies are digest-bound and witnessed in the Runtime host namespace across the Attempt.
invariants.negative: Evidence must not claim target private mount/root namespace isolation or proof of consumption.

invariants.name: ProjectionDoesNotAdvance
invariants.rule: Projection-only get/list/read operations do not dispatch, reconcile or mutate execution state.
invariants.negative: Inspection must not accidentally become maintenance.

invariants.name: StructuredRuntimeRelease
invariants.rule: Runtime self-release is an exact reconciliable effect whose receipt is authoritative over transport/process ambiguity.
invariants.negative: Connection loss or generic process exit must not be treated as release outcome.

invariants.name: ToolCatalogIdentity
invariants.rule: Compiled public Tool catalog is deterministic and host extensions/configuration do not silently change the compiled identity.
invariants.negative: Structural refactor must not change catalog count/schema/digest without an explicit public-contract change.

invariants.name: ReconstructibleIndexesNotSemanticSchema
invariants.rule: Performance-only query indexes are recreated idempotently without advancing durable semantic schema.
invariants.negative: Operational performance tuning must not close previous-binary rollback compatibility by itself.

invariants.name: MechanicalNotSemanticCompletion
invariants.rule: Runtime reports physical execution/delivery/recovery truth and keeps semanticCompletionEvaluated=false.
invariants.negative: Process success must not become Task/domain semantic completion.

negativeArchitectureConstraints: No provider marketplace or cross-node scheduler.
No Host Task or Harness cognition authority.
